entries.spec: Inspect package.json for the express-rate-limit dependency.
Review the middleware factory file for an exported function accepting { windowMs, max } and returning a configured rateLimit() instance with a custom handler.
entries.expected: The factory matches the stated parameters and returns a rateLimit instance with a custom handler.

entries.spec: Send 6 POST requests to the login route from the same IP within 15 minutes.
entries.expected: The first 5 requests are not rate-limited; the 6th returns HTTP 429.

entries.spec: Inspect the 429 response headers and body from the exceeded request.
entries.expected: The response includes a Retry-After header in seconds and JSON body { "error": "Too many requests", "retryAfter": <seconds> }.

entries.spec: Review app/router wiring to confirm the middleware is applied only to the login route.
entries.expected: No global rateLimit middleware or other-route rateLimit middleware is added.

entries.spec: Review the rate-limit configuration and imports for storage.
entries.expected: The default in-memory store is used; no Redis or external dependency is configured.

entries.spec: Review the diff for changes to existing route handlers or business logic.
entries.expected: Only the middleware factory, login route wiring, and dependency files change.
